steps.text: Talk to Dimintheis in south east Varrock.
choices: Why would a nobleman live in a dump like this?

choices: So can I have your bit?

steps.text: Talk to Caleb again with the required fish.
Talk to Caleb in Catherby once more.
choices: Uh.. what happened to the rest of the crest?

steps.text: Talk to the Gem Trader in Al Kharid.
choices: I'm in search of a man named Avan Fitzharmon.

steps.text: Talk to the man south of the Al Kharid mine.
choices: I'm looking for a man named Avan Fitzharmon.

steps.text: Talk to Boot in the south western Dwarven Mines.
Talk to Boot in the south western Dwarven Mines.
choices: Hello. I'm in search of very high quality gold.

steps.text: Enter the old ruin entrance west of Witchaven.
Follow the path around, and pull the lever on the wall in the north east corner.
Pull the lever in the south room up.
Pull the north wall lever again.
Pull the lever in the north room up.
Pull the north wall lever again.
Pull the lever in the south room down.
Follow the dungeon around to the east.
Mine 2 perfect gold in the east room.
Smelt the perfect gold ore into bars.
Make a perfect ruby necklace at a furnace. Make sure to only craft one.
Make a perfect ruby ring at a furnace. Make sure to only craft one.
Return to the man south of the Al Kharid mine.
Go upstairs in the Jolly Boar Inn north east of Varrock and talk to Johnathon.

steps.text: Enter the Edgeville Wilderness Dungeon, ready to kill Chronozon. Other players will be able to attack you.
Kill Chronozon in the south west corner of the Edgeville Wilderness Dungeon. You need to hit him at least once with all 4 elemental blast spell.
Pick up the crest part.
Combine the 3 crest parts together.
Return the family crest to Dimintheis in south east Varrock.
